webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.desc: We send a POST with signed JSON to your URL when an event happens. Failed deliveries are retried.
webhooks.eventsCount: {count, plural, =0 {None selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}
webhooks.signatureHelp: Each delivery carries the header Zerosoft-Signature: t=…,v1=… where v1 is the HMAC-SHA256 of "t.body" with your secret. Compare it before trusting the body.
webhooks.secretWarning: Copy it now: you won't see it again.
webhooks.removeConfirm: Delete the webhook to {url}? We stop sending it events.
webhooks.emptyBody: Add a URL to receive events from bookings, links, contacts, companies, deals, tasks, quotes, forms and robots.
webhooks.adminOnly: Only owners and admins manage webhooks.

errors.private_host: That host points to a private network.
errors.unresolvable_host: That host does not resolve. Check the domain.

linkFilter.title: Only for some links
linkFilter.help: Applies to link events. Leave everything empty to receive events from every link. With several filters, a link has to match all of them.
linkFilter.linksPlaceholder: Slugs separated by commas: promo, launch

propertyFilter.title: Only these properties
propertyFilter.help: For property change events. Use the column name (lifecycle_stage) or custom. plus the field name (custom.plan). Leave it empty to receive every property.

log.title: Deliveries
log.empty: No deliveries yet. Send a test to see one here.

webhooks.payloadHidden: The body was built with the access of the person who owned this webhook then: only they can see it.
webhooks.resendNotOwner: Only the person whose access built this delivery can resend it.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.desc: Keys and tokens used by Flow nodes and Robots steps. Stored encrypted; secrets are never shown.

link.title: Link data
link.desc: Custom domains and the Bitly import live in Link.
link.exportDesc: The CSV has one row per link. The JSON adds every click with referrer, country and device.

members.listDesc: People who work in this workspace.

members.removeBody: They lose access to every app right away: their sessions, API keys and calendar slots stop working and their open conversations go back to the queue. What they created stays in the workspace.
members.leaveBody: You lose access to its apps and data. To come back, someone has to invite you again.
members.alone: It's just you for now. Invite your team above and they'll see the same CRM, Docs, Track and the rest.
members.pendingDesc: Invitations nobody accepted yet. Resending renews the 14 days.
